final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* --- bias branch: diode PMOS + resistor string (~1 uA) ---
Mpd  pb    pb    vdd  vdd  pfet W=1  L=0.5
Ra   pb    vb    50k
Rb   vb    vss   830k
Cb   vb    vss   1p
Cpb  pb    vdd   1p
* --- cascoded CS gain stage; IREF (into ibias) + Mp1 form the load ---
M1   nc    iin   vss  vss  nfet W=36 L=0.15
M2   ibias vb    nc   vss  nfet W=12 L=0.15
Mp1  ibias pb    vdd  vdd  pfet W=1  L=0.5 m=9
* --- shunt feedback ---
Rf   ibias iin   470k
Cf   ibias iin   1f
* --- PMOS source-follower output buffer (bulk tied to source) ---
Msf  vss   ibias vout vout pfet W=24 L=0.15
Mp2  vout  pb    vdd  vdd  pfet W=1  L=0.5 m=8
.ends
